includes: image verification/read, full encode, features+PMF or channel+decode; both paths include source I/O; warm OS cache; unamortized per query
excludes: common original-image generation, one-time fitting/calibration (recorded separately), network download and serialization of final tables
interpretation: We measure single-query latency including backend policy and transfer overhead, and record large-batch numerical throughput separately in the original archive. We compare prediction with exact replay; kernel throughput alone does not establish end-to-end acceleration.
